### 📋 Pre-Submission Checklist
Please check the following before submitting:

- [ ] **(Required)** I confirm that this photo is copyright-safe and family-friendly (SFW).

- **Proposed File Name:** (e.g., `poop.jpg` - lowercase `.jpg`)

### ⚖️ Copyright & Licensing Attestation
Please verify and confirm the licensing terms:
- [ ] **(Required)** I personally took this photograph, **OR** it is verified to be under **CC0 / Public Domain / Royalty-Free Creative Commons**.
- [ ] **(Required)** I grant permission for this photo to be bundled and distributed in this open-source project under the [ISC License](../../LICENSE).
- **Original Source / License Proof (URL or Camera Info):** _______________

### 📐 Image Optimization Checklist
Please ensure the photo meets technical requirements before submitting:
- [ ] File format is `.jpg`.
- [ ] File size is compressed to `< 100 KB` (to ensure instantaneous Discord delivery).
- [ ] Image resolution is clear, sharp, and centered on the capybara.
- [ ] Photo contains no watermarks, timestamps, or personal identifiable information.
